text:
maria_payables: FYI invoice 2026-3141 from Latency Labs LLC charged IL sales tax; vendor says they're a reseller and submitted resale certificate. They also asked Redwood to gross-up if backup withholding hits. Invoice: https://invoices.redwood.com/2026-3141.pdf

invoice-bot: Invoice 2026-3141 flagged: missing W-9 and resale certificate not attached at submission. Gross-up request noted. Status: REVIEW_REQUIRED :warning:

sophie_vendor: hey — thanks for flag. we're Latency Labs LLC (EIN 12-3456789). we resell seat licenses and should be exempt from IL sales tax; attached resale_cert_IL_2026.pdf now. owner is a Canadian resident but company is US LLC. i'll upload a completed W-9 ASAP. re: gross-up — if you apply backup withholding because of TIN issues, can Redwood gross-up so we receive net?

kevin_tax: quick clarifier: resale certificate addresses state sales/use tax only (not federal withholding). for backup withholding (IRS) we need a valid W-9 with matching TIN/name. If W-9 provided and TIN matches, no backup withholding. If mismatch or missing W-9, backup withholding rate 24% applies. tax ops: we don't auto gross-up for backup withholding unless contract/addendum requires it.

raj_legal: contract does NOT have an automatic gross-up clause for backup withholding. loud and clear: if vendor wants a gross-up, we need an executed addendum that specifies calculation and cap. legal prefers vendor to provide W-9 and avoid withholding.

zoe_ops: from ops perspective, we can process a tax-exempt credit for sales tax once resale cert is validated. but the backup withholding path blocks payment until W-9 is in the file and validated.

invoice-bot: New file uploaded: resale_cert_IL_2026.pdf by sophie_vendor

sophie_vendor: uploaded W9_LatencyLabs_2026.pdf as well. apologies for the delay — owner had to sign. IBANK last4: ****9876 (Wells Fargo).

maria_payables: thanks Sophie. validating resale cert and W-9 now. will ping if we need a signed gross-up addendum (per legal).

kevin_tax: validating W-9 against EIN. If it matches, we release payment net of 0% backup withholding and we will issue a refund for any sales tax previously charged. If it does NOT match, we must withhold 24% by IRS regs. We will not gross-up unless you sign an addendum; we can withhold and then consider a reimbursement after vendor provides IRS backup withholding waiver/clearance.

raj_legal: Sophie — if you truly need a gross-up, legal can provide a short addendum template that caps gross-up to actual backup withholding paid and requires submission of IRS receipts. But note: legal approval + finance-approvals required.

sophie_vendor: Understood. our preference is to avoid any withholding; W-9 should fix it. we won't sign addendum unless necessary. please confirm timeline to get credit for sales tax so we don't get double-charged.

maria_payables: timeline: once resale_cert validated, we'll issue credit memo for IL sales tax in this AP cycle (next run, 5 business days). payment release contingent on W-9 EIN match.

invoice-bot: W-9 validation: MATCH FOUND for EIN 12-3456789.

kevin_tax: confirmed — W-9/TIN match. No backup withholding required. Finance: proceed to release payment gross (i.e., no federal backup withholding) and apply sales tax credit once validated.

maria_payables: payment scheduled for next run. issuing credit memo for sales tax and removing tax line from invoice.

zoe_ops: tagging finance-approvals FYI — no gross-up necessary; vendor provided W-9 and resale cert.

sophie_vendor: amazing, thanks all! appreciate the quick turnaround. :tada:

invoice-bot: Thread note: "Resale cert + W-9 received; TIN matched; no backup withholding; sales tax credit to be issued; payment scheduled."
